title: Amazing experience
text: Isac made our visit to the Sagrada Família truly memorable. His knowledge went well beyond facts and dates—he helped us understand the stories, symbolism, and imagination behind this extraordinary place. Warm, witty, and engaging, he made the tour feel like a conversation, with plenty of fascinating insights and laughter along the way. We left with a deeper appreciation of Gaudí’s vision and were so glad we’d explored it with him. Highly recommended!
author: alexiorgulescu
